name: Azərbaycan adları (Azərbaycan Respublikasının Ədliyyə Nazirliyi)
note: The Ministry of Justice's register of names that may be entered in Azerbaijani civil
records, 5,039 of them, each with an etymology. A register of what is permitted rather
than a count of who holds what -- so the values ship unweighted, which is what the data
CC0, read from the portal's own CKAN API as `license_id: cc-zero` rather than off the
page. Nothing to reconcile with Apache-2.0 and no attribution obligation; NOTICE names
Given names and surnames share the file and are told apart by the etymology text, which
opens `familiya,` for a family name. A prose field used as a flag is fragile, so the
adapter asserts the count instead of trusting it: a change in how the Ministry writes
its descriptions fails the build rather than silently reclassifying 1,385 surnames.
